_doc: Goods hung from the store's beaded ceiling (#1182 G3, bolder in #1192 G4): a string of seven tin pails, 10 qt, hung by their bails from a bar on two cords (four close under the bar, three on long cords behind: a hardware shop's cheapest sign). A prop that hangs by a hook (GlassProp, as the hanging lamp: it swings when pushed, and falls whole if the board it hangs from goes; its parts never shatter). Baked the gun way (tools/blender/props/store_g3.py: model hung_pails). Written by tools/props/store_g3.py.
